level.title: Level 3: Extended Elementary & Conversational Fluency
level.description: Transisi menuju kemandirian berbahasa: kuasai bentuk continuous, rencana masa depan (will vs going to), perbandingan benda dan tempat, serta percakapan sosial nyata.

modules.title: Present Continuous: Actions Happening Now
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan rumus To Be (Am/Is/Are) + Verb-ing untuk menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat berbicara tanpa menghilangkan to be.

content.summary: Present Continuous digunakan untuk menyatakan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung tepat saat kita berbicara atau situasi sementara di masa sekarang.

rules.example: I am studying English right now.
She is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
They are waiting for the bus outside.

rules.pattern: Negasi & Tanya: is/are not & Am/Is/Are + Subject + Verb-ing?
rules.example: He is not sleeping. Are you listening to me?

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Fatal: Menghilangkan To Be Sebelum Verb-ing
commonTrap.explanation: Bahasa Indonesia tidak mengenal kata kerja bantu 'to be', sehingga banyak pemula langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya makan' menjadi 'I eating'. Ingat: Verb-ing TIDAK BISA berdiri sendiri tanpa am/is/are.
commonTrap.wrong: I studying now. / She cooking dinner.
commonTrap.correct: I am studying now. / She is cooking dinner.

commonMistakes.wrong: I studying now. / She cooking dinner.
commonMistakes.right: I am studying now. / She is cooking dinner.
commonMistakes.note: Bahasa Indonesia tidak mengenal kata kerja bantu 'to be', sehingga banyak pemula langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya makan' menjadi 'I eating'. Ingat: Verb-ing TIDAK BISA berdiri sendiri tanpa am/is/are.

items.example: He is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
They are studying for tomorrow's English test.
I am waiting for the bus at the stop.
She is running in the park this morning.
Who is calling you on the phone?
We are listening to the teacher carefully.
Look outside, it is raining heavily.
My father is working from home today.

modules.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous: Habits vs Temporary Actions
modules.objective: Mampu membedakan dengan tepat kapan menggunakan Present Simple (fakta/rutinitas) dan Present Continuous (kejadian sementara saat ini).

content.summary: Present Simple digunakan untuk kebiasaan, jadwal, dan fakta umum (every day, always). Sedangkan Present Continuous digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini atau sementara (now, at the moment, this week).

rules.example: I drink coffee every morning. He works in an office.
Look! I am drinking tea right now. He is working from home today.
Always, usually vs Now, at the moment, right now.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Menggunakan Continuous untuk Fakta Umum atau Rutinitas
commonTrap.explanation: Jangan gunakan Verb-ing untuk fakta permanen atau kebiasaan sehari-hari. 'I am living in Jakarta' menyiratkan tinggal sementara, sedangkan 'I live in Jakarta' menyatakan tempat tinggal tetap.
commonTrap.wrong: I am always drinking coffee every morning. / The sun is rising in the east.
commonTrap.correct: I always drink coffee every morning. / The sun rises in the east.

commonMistakes.wrong: I am always drinking coffee every morning. / The sun is rising in the east.
commonMistakes.right: I always drink coffee every morning. / The sun rises in the east.
commonMistakes.note: Jangan gunakan Verb-ing untuk fakta permanen atau kebiasaan sehari-hari. 'I am living in Jakarta' menyiratkan tinggal sementara, sedangkan 'I live in Jakarta' menyatakan tempat tinggal tetap.

items.example: I usually drink tea, but today I am having coffee.
He is currently living with his brother.
Reading books before sleeping is a healthy habit.
This project is only temporary for three months.
She has a permanent job in Jakarta.
Nowadays, many people are working remotely.
Practice is essential in everyday life.
She cannot answer because she is driving at the moment.

modules.title: Future with 'Be Going To': Plans & Intentions
modules.objective: Mampu menyatakan rencana masa depan yang sudah dipikirkan dan direncanakan sebelumnya menggunakan rumus 'Be Going To + Verb 1'.

content.summary: 'Be Going To' digunakan untuk mengungkapkan rencana masa depan yang sudah diniatkan atau bukti nyata yang terlihat di depan mata.

rules.example: I am going to buy a new laptop next week.

rules.pattern: Negative: am/is/are + not + going to + Verb 1
rules.example: She is not going to attend the party tonight.

rules.pattern: Question: Am/Is/Are + Subject + going to + Verb 1?
rules.example: Are you going to travel to Bali this holiday?
Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Mengira 'Going To' Selalu Berarti Pergi ke Tempat Fisik
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa mengira 'going to' selalu berarti pergi jalan-jalan. 'Be going to + Verb 1' adalah satu kesatuan struktur penunjuk rencana masa depan (akan), diikuti kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to' ganda.
commonTrap.wrong: I am going to to buy a car. / She going to cook dinner.
commonTrap.correct: I am going to buy a car. / She is going to cook dinner.

commonMistakes.wrong: I am going to to buy a car. / She going to cook dinner.
commonMistakes.right: I am going to buy a car. / She is going to cook dinner.
commonMistakes.note: Banyak siswa mengira 'going to' selalu berarti pergi jalan-jalan. 'Be going to + Verb 1' adalah satu kesatuan struktur penunjuk rencana masa depan (akan), diikuti kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to' ganda.

items.example: We have a solid plan for next holiday.
My intention is to improve my spoken English.
They are going to take a vacation in Lombok.
I am going to start a new job next month.
What are you going to cook tonight?
He is going to wash his car tomorrow morning.
She is going to save money for a laptop.
We are going to attend my cousin's wedding.

modules.title: Future with 'Will': Decisions & Predictions
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan modal 'Will / Won't' untuk membuat keputusan spontan, menawarkan bantuan, dan memprediksi masa depan.

content.summary: 'Will' digunakan untuk keputusan spontan yang dibuat saat berbicara, tawaran bantuan, janji, dan prediksi umum tanpa bukti langsung.

rules.example: I am hungry. I will order some food right now.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone your secret.

rules.pattern: Tawaran Bantuan: I will help you...
rules.example: That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it for you.

rules.pattern: Prediksi Opini: I think + Subject + will...
rules.example: I think the weather will be sunny tomorrow.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Menggunakan 'Will' untuk Rencana Matang yang Sudah Dijadwalkan
commonTrap.explanation: Gunakan 'will' saat keputusan baru saja dibuat seketika saat berbicara. Jika tiket sudah dibeli dan tanggal sudah pasti, gunakan 'be going to' atau Present Continuous.
commonTrap.wrong: I will to help you. / She wills come tomorrow.
commonTrap.correct: I will help you. / She will come tomorrow.

commonMistakes.wrong: I will to help you. / She wills come tomorrow.
commonMistakes.right: I will help you. / She will come tomorrow.
commonMistakes.note: Gunakan 'will' saat keputusan baru saja dibuat seketika saat berbicara. Jika tiket sudah dibeli dan tanggal sudah pasti, gunakan 'be going to' atau Present Continuous.

items.example: I will call you when I arrive, I promise.
It was a spontaneous decision to help him.
I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
That box looks heavy. I will carry it for you.
The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
I will decide after the meeting.
He will probably come late tonight.
Don't worry, I won't forget your birthday.

modules.title: Comparatives: Comparing People, Cities & Things
modules.objective: Mampu membandingkan dua benda, orang, atau tempat menggunakan aturan kata sifat 1 suku kata (-er than) dan 2+ suku kata (more ... than).

content.summary: Comparative Adjectives digunakan untuk membandingkan dua orang, tempat, atau benda. Polanya tergantung jumlah suku kata kata sifat (syllables).

rules.example: Jakarta is bigger and hotter than Bandung.
This book is more interesting than the movie.
Learning English is easier than learning Arabic.
Good -> better than. Bad -> worse than. Far -> farther than.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak orang Indonesia menggabungkan 'more' dengan akhiran '-er'. Cukup pilih salah satu: jika kata pendek tambahkan '-er', jika kata panjang gunakan 'more'.
commonTrap.wrong: This phone is more cheaper. / He is more taller than me.
commonTrap.correct: This phone is cheaper. / He is taller than me.

commonMistakes.wrong: This phone is more cheaper. / He is more taller than me.
commonMistakes.right: This phone is cheaper. / He is taller than me.
commonMistakes.note: Banyak orang Indonesia menggabungkan 'more' dengan akhiran '-er'. Cukup pilih salah satu: jika kata pendek tambahkan '-er', jika kata panjang gunakan 'more'.

items.example: Taking the train is cheaper than taking a taxi.
The airplane is faster than the boat.
My brother is taller than me.
This hotel is more expensive than that motel.
Jakarta is more crowded than Yogyakarta.
Your English pronunciation is much better now.
The traffic today is worse than yesterday.
This lesson is easier than the last one.

modules.title: Superlatives: The Best, Worst & Most
modules.objective: Mampu menyatakan tingkatan tertinggi (paling / ter-) menggunakan pola superlatif 'the -est' dan 'the most'.

content.summary: Superlative Adjectives digunakan untuk menyatakan tingkatan 'paling' atau 'ter-' di antara tiga benda atau lebih dalam satu kelompok.

rules.example: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
This is the most expensive watch in the store.
Friday is the happiest day of the week for me.
The best (terbaik), the worst (terburuk), the farthest (terjauh).

commonTrap.explanation: Bentuk superlatif menunjukkan sesuatu yang unik/spesifik di puncaknya, sehingga kata sandang 'the' WAJIB disertakan sebelum adjective.
commonTrap.wrong: She is best student in class. / It was most beautiful view.
commonTrap.correct: She is the best student in the class. / It was the most beautiful view.

commonMistakes.wrong: She is best student in class. / It was most beautiful view.
commonMistakes.right: She is the best student in the class. / It was the most beautiful view.
commonMistakes.note: Bentuk superlatif menunjukkan sesuatu yang unik/spesifik di puncaknya, sehingga kata sandang 'the' WAJIB disertakan sebelum adjective.

items.example: This is the best restaurant in town.
That was the worst movie I have ever seen.

This diamond ring is the most expensive item.
Cheetahs are the fastest land animals.

modules.title: Modals of Advice: Should & Shouldn't
modules.objective: Mampu memberikan dan meminta saran atau rekomendasi secara sopan menggunakan modal 'should' dan 'shouldn't'.

content.summary: 'Should' dan 'Shouldn't' digunakan untuk memberikan nasihat, saran ramah, atau rekomendasi tentang hal yang baik atau tidak baik dilakukan.

rules.example: You look tired. You should take a break.
You shouldn't drink cold water when you have a sore throat.
What should I wear to the job interview?

rules.meaning: Setelah modal, kata kerja dasar murni
rules.example: You should go (BUKAN: You should to go).

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa terbiasa dengan pola bahasa Indonesia 'kamu harus untuk...', lalu menambahkan 'to' setelah modal. Modal auxiliary WAJIB langsung diikuti Verb 1 telanjang tanpa 'to'.
commonTrap.wrong: You should to see a doctor. / We shouldn't to eat too late.
commonTrap.correct: You should see a doctor. / We shouldn't eat too late.

commonMistakes.wrong: You should to see a doctor. / We shouldn't to eat too late.
commonMistakes.right: You should see a doctor. / We shouldn't eat too late.
commonMistakes.note: Banyak siswa terbiasa dengan pola bahasa Indonesia 'kamu harus untuk...', lalu menambahkan 'to' setelah modal. Modal auxiliary WAJIB langsung diikuti Verb 1 telanjang tanpa 'to'.

items.example: Can you give me some good advice?
I strongly recommend this book.
You look tired, you should rest now.
If you have a headache, you should take medicine.
We should eat healthy vegetables every day.
You shouldn't skip breakfast in the morning.
Everyone should exercise at least three times a week.
You have a toothache, you should see a dentist.

options: You should to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: Modal 'should' selalu diikuti Verb 1 murni tanpa 'to' (should see).

questions.question: Kalimat larangan sopan: 'You ______ drive when you feel sleepy.'
questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't' (sebaiknya tidak) digunakan untuk menasihati agar tidak menyetir saat mengantuk.

questions.question: Susunan kalimat tanya meminta saran yang tepat:
questions.explanation: Inversi pertanyaan modal: WH + should + Subject + V1.

options: Kamu disarankan makan lebih banyak buah.

questions.explanation: Penggunaan 'should to study' salah karena modal tidak boleh diikuti 'to'.

modules.title: Modals of Obligation: Must vs Have to vs Don't Have to
modules.objective: Mampu membedakan keharusan aturan (must/have to), larangan keras (must not), dan ketiadaan keharusan (don't have to).

content.summary: 'Must' dan 'Have to' menyatakan kewajiban/keharusan. 'Mustn't' menyatakan larangan keras (dilarang). Sedangkan 'Don't have to' menyatakan tidak perlu/tidak wajib (opsional).

rules.example: All drivers must stop at the red light. I have to wake up early.
You mustn't smoke in the hospital.

rules.meaning: TIDAK PERLU / Boleh dilakukan, boleh tidak
rules.example: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I don't have to go to work.

rules.pattern: He / She / It + has to + Verb 1
rules.example: She has to wear a uniform at school.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Fatal: Mengira 'Don't have to' Artinya Dilarang
commonTrap.explanation: 'Don't have to' artinya TIDAK HARUS (opsional, jika dilakukan tidak apa-apa). Jika ingin melarang keras karena bahaya atau melanggar aturan, gunakan 'Must not' (Mustn't).
commonTrap.wrong: You don't have to cross the red light. / Students don't have to cheat.
commonTrap.correct: You mustn't run the red light. / Students mustn't cheat.

commonMistakes.wrong: You don't have to cross the red light. / Students don't have to cheat.
commonMistakes.right: You mustn't run the red light. / Students mustn't cheat.
commonMistakes.note: 'Don't have to' artinya TIDAK HARUS (opsional, jika dilakukan tidak apa-apa). Jika ingin melarang keras karena bahaya atau melanggar aturan, gunakan 'Must not' (Mustn't).

items.example: Wearing a helmet is a legal obligation.
You must stop when the traffic light is red.
I have to wake up early for work.
You mustn't smoke in the hospital.
Tomorrow is Sunday, you don't have to work.
Riders must wear a standard helmet.
You must show your passport at airport security.
We must follow the safety rules.

modules.title: Essential Phrasal Verbs 1: Daily Life
modules.objective: Mampu memahami dan menggunakan phrasal verb harian yang paling sering dipakai (wake up, get up, put on, take off, turn on/off, look for).

content.summary: Phrasal Verb adalah kombinasi Kata Kerja (Verb) + Preposisi/Partikel (seperti on, off, up, out) yang menghasilkan makna baru yang berbeda dari kata aslinya.

rules.example: I wake up at six, but I get up at six thirty.
Please turn on the light and turn off the TV.
Put on your jacket. Take off your shoes before entering.
I am looking for my keys. Never give up on your dreams!

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Menerjemahkan Phrasal Verb Kata demi Kata
commonTrap.explanation: Jangan terjemahkan per kata secara harfiah ('turn on' bukan 'putar di atas'). Phrasal verb adalah satu kesatuan kosakata idiomatis yang memiliki arti khusus tersendiri.
commonTrap.wrong: Please open the lamp. / Please close the air conditioner.
commonTrap.correct: Please turn on the lamp. / Please turn off the air conditioner.

commonMistakes.wrong: Please open the lamp. / Please close the air conditioner.
commonMistakes.right: Please turn on the lamp. / Please turn off the air conditioner.
commonMistakes.note: Jangan terjemahkan per kata secara harfiah ('turn on' bukan 'putar di atas'). Phrasal verb adalah satu kesatuan kosakata idiomatis yang memiliki arti khusus tersendiri.

items.example: I usually wake up at 5:30 in the morning.
I wake up at six, but I get up at 6:15.
Please turn on the air conditioner, it is hot.
Remember to turn off the lights before you leave.
Put on your jacket, it is chilly outside.
Please take off your shoes before entering.
I am looking for my car keys.
Never give up on learning English!

modules.title: Conjunctions: Because, So, But, Although
modules.objective: Mampu menggabungkan dua ide menjadi kalimat majemuk logis menggunakan kata penghubung sebab-akibat dan kontras.

content.summary: Kata penghubung (Conjunctions) menghubungkan dua klausa menjadi kalimat utuh. 'Because' menyatakan sebab, 'so' menyatakan akibat, 'but' menyatakan pertentangan sederhana, dan 'although' menyatakan kontras/konsesi.

rules.example: I study English every day because I want to work abroad.
The weather was very bad, so we stayed at home.
English grammar is challenging, but it is very interesting.
Although he was very tired, he finished his assignment.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Menggabungkan 'Because' dan 'So' dalam Satu Kalimat
commonTrap.explanation: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita sering berkata 'Karena saya capek, jadi saya tidur'. Dalam bahasa Inggris, pilih SALAH SATU: gunakan 'Because...' ATAU '..., so...'. Jangan gunakan keduanya sekaligus!
commonTrap.wrong: Because I was tired, so I went to bed early. / Because it rained, so I stayed home.
commonTrap.correct: Because I was tired, I went to bed early. / It rained, so I stayed home.

commonMistakes.wrong: Because I was tired, so I went to bed early. / Because it rained, so I stayed home.
commonMistakes.right: Because I was tired, I went to bed early. / It rained, so I stayed home.
commonMistakes.note: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita sering berkata 'Karena saya capek, jadi saya tidur'. Dalam bahasa Inggris, pilih SALAH SATU: gunakan 'Because...' ATAU '..., so...'. Jangan gunakan keduanya sekaligus!

items.example: I stayed home because it was raining.
I was hungry, so I cooked noodles.
He studied hard, but he failed the test.
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the swim.
The car is old. However, it still runs well.
What is the reason for your absence?
His score was the result of consistent practice.
Conjunctions connect two clauses together.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang BENAR tanpa redundansi bahasa Indonesia?

questions.explanation: 'Because' menjelaskan alasan mengapa mereka tinggal di rumah.

modules.title: Restaurant & Social Logistics: Ordering, Requests & The Bill
modules.objective: Mampu memesan makanan, menanyakan rekomendasi menu, meminta tagihan (bill), dan menyelesaikan urusan di restoran dengan sopan.

content.summary: Kuasai etiket dan frasa sopan bahasa Inggris saat berada di kafe atau restoran: memesan makanan ('I would like...', 'Could I get...'), meminta bantuan ('Excuse me...'), dan meminta tagihan ('Could we have the bill, please?').

rules.pattern: I would like (I'd like) + Noun / to + Verb
rules.example: I would like a cup of hot cappuccino, please.

rules.pattern: Could I get / Could I have + Noun, please?
rules.example: Could I have a glass of water, please?

rules.pattern: Excuse me, could we have the bill / check, please?
rules.example: Excuse me, we are ready to pay. Could we have the bill?

rules.pattern: Do you take credit cards / digital payment?
rules.example: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Menggunakan 'I Want' Saat Memesan Makanan
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak penutur Indonesia langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya mau nasi goreng' menjadi 'I want fried rice'. Dalam standar budaya internasional, 'I want' terdengar menuntut dan kurang sopan. Selalu gunakan 'I would like...' atau 'Could I have...'.
commonTrap.wrong: I want chicken and I want the bill now. / Give me water.
commonTrap.correct: I would like the grilled chicken, please. / Could we have the bill, please?

commonMistakes.wrong: I want chicken and I want the bill now. / Give me water.
commonMistakes.right: I would like the grilled chicken, please. / Could we have the bill, please?
commonMistakes.note: Banyak penutur Indonesia langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya mau nasi goreng' menjadi 'I want fried rice'. Dalam standar budaya internasional, 'I want' terdengar menuntut dan kurang sopan. Selalu gunakan 'I would like...' atau 'Could I have...'.

Are you ready to order, sir?
We will start with soup as our appetizer.
For my main course, I would like grilled chicken.
Could we have the bill, please?

The pasta was absolutely delicious.

modules.title: Full Simulation: Planning a Vacation with a Friend
modules.objective: Mampu memadukan tenses (Present Simple, Continuous, Future Going to/Will), perbandingan, dan ungkapan sopan dalam diskusi merencanakan liburan.

content.summary: Simulasi komprehensif mengintegrasikan seluruh materi Level A1: membuat rencana dengan 'going to', membandingkan opsi dengan 'comparatives/superlatives', menyatakan pendapat dengan 'conjunctions', dan membuat keputusan spontan dengan 'will'.

rules.pattern: Membuat Rencana: We are going to + Verb 1
rules.example: We are going to visit Yogyakarta next month.
Traveling by train is more comfortable than by bus.

rules.pattern: Mengambil Keputusan: I will book / I will check...
rules.example: Great idea! I will book the hotel tickets tonight.
We chose the resort because it is close to the beach.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Bingung Mengombinasikan Tenses dalam Diskusi Rencana
commonTrap.explanation: Dalam percakapan nyata, kita menggunakan beberapa tenses sekaligus: fakta masa kini (Simple Present), rencana yang sudah disepakati (Going to), dan keputusan saat itu juga (Will). Jangan takut memadukannya secara natural.
commonTrap.wrong: We will go because the hotel is more cheaper and yesterday I book it.
commonTrap.correct: We are going to go by train because the ticket is cheaper, and I will book it now.

commonMistakes.wrong: We will go because the hotel is more cheaper and yesterday I book it.
commonMistakes.right: We are going to go by train because the ticket is cheaper, and I will book it now.
commonMistakes.note: Dalam percakapan nyata, kita menggunakan beberapa tenses sekaligus: fakta masa kini (Simple Present), rencana yang sudah disepakati (Going to), dan keputusan saat itu juga (Will). Jangan takut memadukannya secara natural.

items.example: Labuan Bajo is our dream destination.
Let's prepare the travel itinerary together.

The morning flight is cheaper than the afternoon one.

I will book the hotel room tonight.
Don't forget to pack comfortable shoes.
It will be a memorable trip for all of us.

Bali is nice than Bogor, because we go.

questions.question: Maya: 'The tickets are available now!' Raka merespon spontan:
options: I will book them right away!

questions.explanation: Itinerary adalah jadwal rencana detail kegiatan perjalanan.

modules.title: Level A1.3 Comprehensive Graduation Assessment
modules.objective: Ujian komprehensif penentu kelulusan seluruh rumpun Level A1 (A1.1, A1.2, dan A1.3) mencakup tata bahasa, kelancaran bicara, dan pemahaman percakapan.

content.summary: Modul evaluasi kelulusan komprehensif tingkat akhir Level A1. Memvalidasi penguasaan seluruh aspek dasar: tenses (Present, Past, Future), kata ganti, modal verbs, perbandingan, dan kelancaran percakapan fungsional harian.

rules.pattern: Present & Past Mastery: am/is/are, do/does, was/were
rules.example: I am a student. Yesterday I was busy with my exam.

rules.pattern: Continuous & Future: Verb-ing, going to, will
rules.example: Right now I am speaking English, and tomorrow I will graduate.

rules.pattern: Modals & Comparisons: should, must, better, best
rules.example: You must practice every day. This is the best method.
Capai minimal 75% untuk memperoleh sertifikat kelulusan A1.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Terburu-buru: Teliti Bentuk Kata Kerja & To Be
commonTrap.explanation: Pada ujian kelulusan, kesalahan paling sering terjadi karena terburu-buru: lupa menambahkan To Be pada continuous tense, tertukar antara regular/irregular past verb, atau melupakan kata sandang 'the' pada superlative.
commonTrap.wrong: I am study yesterday and tomorrow I go. / She is more taller.
commonTrap.correct: I studied yesterday, I am practicing today, and I will travel tomorrow.

commonMistakes.wrong: I am study yesterday and tomorrow I go. / She is more taller.
commonMistakes.right: I studied yesterday, I am practicing today, and I will travel tomorrow.
commonMistakes.note: Pada ujian kelulusan, kesalahan paling sering terjadi karena terburu-buru: lupa menambahkan To Be pada continuous tense, tertukar antara regular/irregular past verb, atau melupakan kata sandang 'the' pada superlative.

questions.question: Look! The cat ______ on the roof right now.

questions.explanation: 'Take off' berarti melepas pakaian/sepatu.

questions.question: I am ______ my glasses. Have you seen them?
questions.explanation: 'Looking for' berarti mencari barang yang hilang.

questions.question: I stayed up late last night, ______ I feel sleepy today.
questions.explanation: 'So' menunjukkan hubungan akibat/konsekuensi logis.

questions.question: Could we have ______ please? We want to pay now.

questions.question: Bentuk comparative dari 'bad' adalah:
questions.explanation: Bentuk komparatif ireguler dari 'bad' adalah 'worse'.

questions.question: Bentuk superlatif dari 'good' adalah:
questions.explanation: Bentuk superlatif ireguler dari 'good' adalah 'the best'.
